'''Davan Marak''' was a [[humanoid]] [[scavenger]] who spent [[time]] in [[Niima Outpost]] on the [[planet]] [[Jakku]] in [[34 ABY]], just as it came under [[Escape from Jakku|attack]] from the [[First Order]]. The scavenger later posted a job listing in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the planet [[Batuu]], asking for someone to verify that there was an [[X-34 landspeeder]] at [[Black Spire Station]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|This is exactly what I needed, thanks! Here are some credits for the effort.|Davan Marak thanks the traveler for checking the landspeeder|<ref name="Datapad" />}}
[[File:Stormtroopers_and_Marak.png|thumb|left|300px|alt=Two First Order stormtroopers with their weapons drawn move toward the viewer. Davan Marak and another individual are visible in the distance standing in the desert sands of Jakku.|Davan Marak was approaching Niima Outpost as the First Order attacked.]]
Davan Marak was a [[scavenger]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> who was active in [[Niima Outpost]] on the [[desert]] [[planet]] [[Jakku]].<ref name="TFA">{{Film|VII}}</ref> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[34 ABY]],<ref name="SWGA">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]'' dates the events of {{Film|VII}} to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Marak was approaching the outpost on [[Limb|foot]] alongside another individual when it came [[Escape from Jakku|under attack]] by the [[First Order]] military faction, which was searching for the [[astromech droid]] [[BB-8]].<ref name="TFA" />

In [[34 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]], which include Davan Marak's appearance in [[Star Wars: Datapad|''Star Wars'': Datapad]], to [[34 ABY]].</ref> Marak came to need an [[X-34 landspeeder]] for parts and learned that such a [[Landspeeder|vehicle]] could be found at [[Black Spire Station]] in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on the planet [[Batuu]]. During the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of the world, the scavenger made a posting on the job board in the outpost and messaged an interested party, asking them to check that the [[speeder]] at the station was of the right make. After Marak's contact confirmed the model of the vehicle, the scavenger messaged them thanks and sent them one hundred [[Galactic Credit Standard|credits]].<ref name="Datapad" />

==Personality and traits==
Marak was a [[Color|dark]]-skinned [[humanoid]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

==Equipment==
Marak wore a [[Clothing|scavenger's apron]] over a black shirt along with white [[boot]]s and a [[Star|sun]]-shielding [[sedge hat]].<ref name="TFAVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:LEGO_Davan_Marak.png|thumb|right|150px|alt=A LEGO version of Davan Marak with light tan clothing stands in the desert on Jakku with a brown blaster pistol in hand. Through an opening on the character's conical hat a light-skinned face is visible.|Marak's LEGO form has several inconsistencies.]]
Davan Marak first appeared in the [[2015]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. The character was not identified in the film,<ref name="TFA" /> but received a name in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a reference book written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]]<ref name="TFAVD" /> and released in conjunction with the film.<ref name="New Books">{{SW|url=news/a-galaxy-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens-books-coming-december-18-first-look|text=A Galaxy of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Books Coming December 18 - UPDATED!}}</ref>

Despite Marak clearly being shown to have dark skin in ''The Visual Dictionary'',<ref name="TFAVD" /> the [[LEGO]] model for the character in the [[2016]] non-[[canon]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]'' has fair skin. The character's clothing is also far lighter in color. The game depicts Marak wielding a [[staff]], a [[thermal detonator]], and a [[blaster pistol]].<ref name="LEGO">''[[LEGO Star Wars: The Force Awakens]]''</ref>
